## Getting started

:::: {.student-steps}

::: {.student-step}

[01]{.card-number}

### Choose a task

You could start by modeling a radio channel, comparing two transmission methods or testing an idea from a paper. Together, we will define the task and identify what you need to solve it.

:::

::: {.student-step}

[02]{.card-number}

### Learn the methods

The work involves programming, mathematical models and research papers. You can learn the methods through your chosen task and discuss questions with the team.

:::

::: {.student-step}

[03]{.card-number}

### Test and explain your results

Run simulations or experiments, compare the results and explain your conclusions. The work may form the basis of a course project, a thesis or a research paper.

:::

::::

You are also welcome to visit the laboratory at Room 317, 47 Vershinina Street, Tomsk. (Monday–Friday, 10:00–17:00)
